headline: Quiet day: Carney flags AI dependence, AI-designed vaccine clears trial
body: A quiet day. Ahead of the G7, Canada's Mark Carney said the US order that took Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 offline shows allies must not rely on a few US models. That is a crack in Global Coordination, which nudges Gatekeeper down. A lightly sourced report of an AI-designed vaccine component passing a first human trial added a little to Capability Velocity. Horizon Balance: +1.78.
movers_note: Barely any movement: Reversion -0.1, Conquerors +0.1, Zookeeper +0.1. Carney's remarks trimmed Gatekeeper (-0.07 from that event) while the vaccine report lifted capability-linked endings slightly.
coming_up: G7 leaders' summit (upcoming; referenced by Carney, date not given in the event)
